text:
maria.k: Quick sync — onboarding RKV (Reykjavik) region. Blockers: S3 residency ACL + egress routing. Planning MVP cutover Tue 10:00 UTC. Need owners for: S3 bucket residency confirmation, KMS key usage, and outbound egress policy.

sean_m: I can take the S3/KMS check. Which buckets are in scope?

maria.k: Thanks. Scope is: logs-redwood-rkv, model-cache-rkv, customer-uploads-rkv. Only customer-uploads must be residency-restricted; others can replicate.

anita: @sean_m note the customer-uploads bucket was created with the default replication flag off. You'll need to set replication role + KMS key alias. I left a TODO in infra repo PR: https://git.redwood/infra/replication/PR-478

sean_m: grabbing that PR. Quick question on KMS: do we reuse existing EU KMS or create a region-specific key? Legal wanted key material separation for regulated customers. @legal-bot any hard requirement?

legal-bot: For GDPR-heavy customers we require region-bound CMKs and no multi-region replication of key material. If a customer opts in to EU-only residency, generate a region-specific CMK and document key policy. (See compliance playbook).

jamal: Tagging infra-oncall for egress planning — are we using NAT gateways or private egress via our proxy peering?

infra-oncall: For RKV we'll route outbound via proxy-edge in AMS with forced-TCP-tunnel to preserve egress IP ranges. Need to confirm BGP peering with the Reykjavik colo. Also need firewall allowlist for our S3 endpoints.

maria.k: Can you paste the route policy we expect so I can add to the cutover checklist?

infra-oncall: Sure — current minimal egress route snippet:

```
# route-policy for rkv -> ams-proxy
match prefix-set RKV_LOCAL_NETS then accept
set next-hop 10.4.1.1
set community 64512:100
```

Also ensure SNAT on the proxy is set to 3.120.45.0/27

sean_m: For S3 residency ACLs, I'll apply the bucket policy template and lock replication for customer-uploads:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Deny", "Principal": "*", "Action": "s3:ReplicateObject", "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::customer-uploads-rkv/*", "Condition": {"StringNotEquals": {"aws:SourceAccount": "123456789012"}}}
  ]
}
```

Will also create KMS alias `alias/redwood/rkv/customer-uploads`.

anita: FYI the infra PR also includes an RBAC change — service account `replicator@infra` needs kms:Encrypt and kms:Decrypt on the new CMK. I left a note in PR-478.

maria.k: Who owns the canary? @deploy-bot what windows do we have?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for Tue 10:00 UTC -> 10:30 UTC. Steps: 1) apply S3 policy, 2) provision CMK, 3) update route policy, 4) launch canary jobs (3 shards). Automated rollback at 10:22 if error rate > 2% or p50 latency > 400ms.

jamal: I'll run the canary jobs and watch metrics. Ping me when policies are applied.

sean_m: I'm pushing a small PR to set the bucket policy + kms alias now: https://git.redwood/infra/replication/PR-481 — @anita can you review RBAC bits?

anita: On it. If tests pass, I'll merge before 08:00 UTC tomorrow.

maria.k: Other dependencies: networking needs a firewall exception for 3.120.45.0/27 to S3 endpoints (s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com). @infra-oncall can you confirm firewall task ID?

infra-oncall: Raised ticket NET-9203. Targeting completion by 07:30 UTC Tue.

legal-bot: Also log the customer opt-in for region-only storage in the DPA registry before cutover.

maria.k: Action items summary:
- sean_m: apply bucket policy + create CMK alias (PR-481) — due Mon 07:00 UTC
- anita: review RBAC & merge infra PR-478 — due Mon 08:00 UTC
- infra-oncall: complete firewall + BGP peering checks (NET-9203) — due Tue 07:30 UTC
- jamal: run canary and monitor metrics Tue 10:00 UTC
- legal-bot: confirm DPA registry entry — due Mon 12:00 UTC

If everyone ACKs I'll add to the cutover runbook. :white_check_mark:

sean_m: ACK

anita: ACK

infra-oncall: ACK — BGP smoke tested in staging, will mirror to prod on Monday night.

jamal: ACK — will be online Tue 09:30 UTC to prep.

maria.k: Thanks all. I'll update the runbook and ping again if anything slips.
